text:
Well, they were already saying it would come to

this: old, talent gone, stumbling over

words.

Hearing dull

footsteps, I turn,

look behind me...

not yet, old dog.

Too soon.

Now

they are sitting talking about

me: "yes, it has happened to him, he's finished... it's a

shame."

"He was never much, was he?"

"Well... no, but now...?"

Now

they are celebrating my demise

in taverns I no longer

frequent.

Now

I drink alone

inside this defective

machine

while the shadows take on

forms

I fight in slow

retreat

now

the promise I was

diminishes

diminishes

now

I light other cigarettes

pour myself other

drinks

it has been a beautiful

fight

and still

is.

translation.title: Cornered
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the aging poet's defiance, tavern gossip, and beautiful ongoing fight.
